name: Houkiboshi
source:
A graceful doll with a calm and careful personality.
She is always of good cheer, calming everyone around her.

She is like everyone's big sister as she was manufactured in the early stages of the Great War. Given the personal backgrounds of the dolls around her, she feels concerned about them and wishes to stay close to them.

She is in charge of the kitchen with her expert cooking skills.
She writes in her diary every day without fail.

Favorite activity: Writing a diary, writing letters
Dream: To sing with a loud voice

[From [url=https://key.visualarts.gr.jp/primadoll/]official site[/url]]
